replace: const fresh = tank.aiRetargetReason === 'target-lost' ? undefined : selectPerceived(world, tank, cfg);
why: Refuses to re-select once a target has been lost, which leaves an AI permanently blind to an opponent that RESPAWNS. `stepRespawns` revives a tank in place -- same id, `alive` back to true -- so nothing about the world tells the AI a new opponent has appeared; it has to re-read `isTargetable` every tick, and this mutation is what 'remembering the loss' looks like as a plausible optimisation. Every other case in the file still passes: death dropping the commitment is unaffected, and no other fixture brings a dead tank back.
killedBy: committed opponent selection reacquires a target that dies and RESPAWNS, rather than staying blind to it
